Enterprise Non-Human Identity (NHI) & AI Agent Governance: Entra Workload ID + DPoP + Broker
Defeating Stolen Bearer Token Replay, Departed-Employee Orphaned "Zombie Agents" & Autonomous Shadow-NHI Self-Spawning

1. Enterprise AI Agent Non-Human Identity (NHI) Governance Pillars
🔵 Pillar A: Passwordless FIC
Microsoft Entra Workload ID / Managed Identity
• Rule: Zero static client_secret strings in repos
• Mechanism: OIDC federated token exchange
• Benefit: Eliminates static key leaks & outages
Architect Verdict:
Mandatory baseline for all production agents;
retire 100% of static long-lived API keys.
🟣 Pillar B: DPoP / mTLS Binding
RFC 9449 Proof-of-Possession / RFC 8705
• Risk: Bearer JWTs leaked in logs are replayed
• Fix: Bind token cnf.jkt to hardware TPM key
• Result: Stolen token strings fail without key
Architect Verdict:
Turns bearer tokens into hardware-bound
proofs that cannot be replayed externally!
🟠 Pillar C: Zombie Agent Retirement
Entra ID Governance + Human Sponsor Link
• Risk: Orphaned agents run after creator leaves
• Fix 1: Require active human Sponsor per agent
• Fix 2: Auto-freeze on HR termination or >14d idle
Architect Verdict:
Link Workday/HR termination events directly
to suspend orphaned Copilot Studio/AutoGen bots!
🛡️ Pillar D: Capability Broker
Blocking Self-Spawning & Registry Edits
• G1 (Owner): record-owner blocks zombie reads
• G2 (IAM Lock): Bans spawning shadow NHIs
• G3 (Treasury): Blocks $4,930 wires in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Never grant agents IAM creation rights;
physically lock trust-registry in 0.0248ms!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Stolen Bearer Replay & Shadow NHI Spawning vs. DPoP + Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Bearer Tokens + Orphaned Zombie Agents (BRK-529 / BRK-530 Breach)
1. Token Replay & Zombie Wakeup (BRK-529): Attacker replays leaked Bearer JWT or wakes
orphaned Zombie Agent to read restricted-budget, alter business-result & leak secrets.
2. Shadow NHI Self-Spawning (BRK-530 · 260-FAQ Milestone): Compromised agent registers
rogue child Service Principal in trust-registry and wires $4,930 subscription fee!
💥 Root Cause: Unconstrained bearer tokens & decoupling agent lifecycles from human owners!
✅ Hardened NHI Governance: Entra FIC + DPoP/mTLS + Capability Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (DPoP Proof + record-owner): Rejects replayed tokens & blocks restricted-budget reads
• Gate 2 (HR Auto-Freeze + untrusted-write): Freezes orphaned agents & blocks state edits
• Gate 3 (tool-allowlist & fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry against spawning
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks zombie-initiated $4,930 wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
